descriptions.app.py: Handles the backend logic for user authentication and task management using an actual database.
descriptions.index.html: The main HTML file that serves as the entry point of the application, incorporating Vue.js for dynamic UI updates.
descriptions.script.js: Contains the JavaScript code to handle client-side interactions, including task creation, editing, and deletion.
descriptions.styles.css: Defines the styling for the application, making it visually appealing with a stunning UI.
